prompt.alinti: Here's how you set this up. Start with creating the scanner layer. But don't waste expensive model tokens to watch raw price charts. Set up Kimmy K3 Swarm Max which sets up 300 different mini agents all watching different things. Some watch stock order books while others watch option flows. Then feed this data into Astra. Astra acts as your senior quant researcher. It analyzes the mispricing using proven frameworks like the Heston volatility model and then writes the execution code to run a five-year backtest.

Then run an automated validation agent that checks the backtest and rejects any strategy unless it's a sharp ratio above 1.5 or a drawdown below 15%. Connect it to your telegram so it always sends real-time alerts.
Then you can connect the system together using GrokBot with eight different agents working together.
I created a step-by-step guide with the agent architecture to build this out.
